overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator. Also corrected direction on out-parameters (doc arrow column shows them as command outputs, not inputs) which the mechanical parser had defaulted to 'in'.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: variableFrame
params.description: True = Variable frame printing, False = Fixed frame printing

params.name: fixedSubform
params.description: Option for printing subforms in fixed size

sentinelValues.meaning: Print Frame fixed with truncation: only records that fit the subform area are printed once; the rest are ignored.
Print Frame fixed with multiple records: the frame stays the same size but 4D reprints the form as many times as needed to include all records.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: The OBJECT GET PRINT VARIABLE FRAME command gets the current configuration of the variable frame print options for the object(s) designated by the object and * parameters.

constraints: fixedSubform is only meaningfully returned when object is a subform and variableFrame comes back False (fixed frame printing); it is not populated for non-subform objects or when variable frame printing is enabled.
